forcedChoices.reason: The adjectives agree with the masculine noun «Espíritu»; the English has no gender. «la Ministra Divina» keeps the feminine title from the glossary.
Spanish forces a gender on the adjective; feminine matches the glossary forms «Ministra Divina» and «asociada creativa» for the Mother Spirit.

forcedChoices.choice: «Ocúpate de los asuntos de tu hermano»
forcedChoices.reason: The words go to one Son, so «tú».
The command goes to all mortals, so the plural «ustedes» form.
Keeps «come again» literally instead of «volveré», which reads as a return only.

forcedChoices.choice: Puede que estos seres no alcancen el Paraíso
forcedChoices.reason: English «may not» is open between possibility and permission; «puede que no» keeps it open as far as Spanish allows.
